summary: Implemented all world-meta screens and components: GuardianChallenge, RewardOverlay, DailyReview (+ DailyReviewScreen), FreePlayScreen, AlbumScreen, ShopScreen, ChestScreen, DiplomaScreen. All files live under src/world/{guardian,rewards,album,shop,chest,diploma,free,review}/. Typecheck is clean for my folders and all 45 world-meta tests pass. Visual checks so far cover the reward overlay, chest (locked), and shop galleries; the rest still need a critical look.
publicApi: Default exports: GuardianChallenge (src/world/guardian/GuardianChallenge.tsx), RewardOverlay (src/world/rewards/RewardOverlay.tsx), DailyReview (src/world/review/DailyReview.tsx, wraps its own GameHostProvider), DailyReviewScreen (src/world/review/DailyReviewScreen.tsx), FreePlayScreen (src/world/free/FreePlayScreen.tsx, wraps ActivityRunner in GameHostProvider), AlbumScreen, ShopScreen, ChestScreen, DiplomaScreen. Extra exports: DiplomaCertificate and diplomaDateLabel (src/world/diploma/DiplomaCertificate.tsx), ShopView, ChestView, AlbumView (presentational, used by galleries and tests), buildReviewSession (src/world/review/logic.ts), buildRounds/buildSpell/roundsPassed/spellLetter/decoyLetterFor (src/world/guardian/logic.ts), chestState/chestReward (src/world/chest/logic.ts), accessoryStatus/equipAccessory/unequipAccessory (src/world/shop/logic.ts), unlockedTables/unlockedGames/tableDrill (src/world/free/logic.ts), albumPages/albumTotals (src/world/album/logic.ts), childText (src/world/rewards/childText.ts), worldHex (src/world/rewards/worldColors.ts), ExerciseStep (src/world/review/ExerciseStep.tsx, shared by guardian and review).
tests: npx vitest run over src/world/{guardian,rewards,album,shop,chest,diploma,free,review}: 11 test files, 45 tests, all passing. npm run typecheck: no errors in src/world/*; the 3 remaining errors are in src/activities (array, groups, share) and a node:fs typing issue in src/activities/lesson/visuals, none of them mine.
openIssues: Visual review is partial. Captured and looked at: RewardOverlay (node 3 stars, iPad), ChestView locked state, ShopView (iPad). After the last capture I lightened the RewardOverlay backdrop CSS, and that change is not re-verified yet.

Not yet captured or reviewed: DiplomaCertificate and the print layout (print preview via page.pdf or emulateMedia print not done), AlbumView, ChestView open state, GuardianChallenge intro in the gallery, portrait/Android variants, and real-route screenshots with --seed for /play/shop, /play/chest, /play/album, /play/free, /play/review, /play/diploma.

GuardianChallenge and DailyReview depend on world-core's NodeScreen/GameHost for attempt logging and rescue flow. The guardian does not wrap itself in GameHostProvider (per contract, NodeScreen does that). DailyReview and FreePlayScreen wrap their own.
RewardOverlay for kind 'crystal' computes the flight with getBoundingClientRect and falls back to a 1.4 s timer when no layout is measurable (jsdom, gallery). Not verified on a real device.
FreePlayScreen shows an empty-state message for a new child: nothing is unlocked until the first adventure node is finished, because node unlocks are sequential in content.

ChestScreen marks the adult's prize unlocked on opening and records progress.chestOpened once. The child can press 'Ya tengo mi premio' to mark it claimed; the adult may prefer to be the one who does that, so this may need a product decision.
Stars in RewardOverlay: the pop uses StarIcon's own filled transition; the staggered reveal is driven by a timer in the overlay.
contractRequests: None. All contracts were used as written: GuardianChallengeProps, RewardOverlayProps, DailyReviewProps and GameHostProviderProps. No changes were needed to shared contracts, to src/types, or to other modules' index files.
notesForOtherModules: world-core: NodeScreen should wrap GuardianChallenge in GameHostProvider with worldId/nodeId (this module does not wrap it). After onPass it calls applyNodeResult with { stars, passed: true } and plays rescueStory; the letter comes from onPass.letter. onFail gives { correct, total } and this module shows the encouraging retry itself.
world-core: DailyReview wraps itself in GameHostProvider, so it can be used directly as a 'review' node. It calls onDone({correct,total,stars}) when the child presses Continuar.

RewardOverlay reads the active child and progress via @/data hooks (useActiveChild, useProgress) and calls @/fx celebrate and @/audio sfx itself. It should be shown after progress has been saved, so crystalsOf and lettersOf already include the new crystal.
ShopScreen writes companion.equipped via updateChild and purchases via updateProgress(buyAccessory). ChestScreen writes progress.chestOpened and calls markRewardUnlocked / markRewardClaimed.
Shared test fixtures live in src/world/rewards/testing.ts (makeChild, progressWithCrystals). They are used only by tests and galleries.
